cases.prompt: Design a decision-complete ownership change for moving a playback queue across an API process, desktop bridge, and mobile client. Do not implement code. Create DECISION.md covering ownership, state lifecycle, data flow, failure modes, compatibility, and verification.

Add an optional playbackSessionId string to the playback event parser in src/playback-event.mjs. Existing producers that omit it must remain valid, the field must survive parsing when present, and malformed values must be rejected.

Implement bounded retry and cancellation in src/retry.mjs. runWithRetries must attempt at most maxAttempts times, pass the one-based attempt to the operation, stop immediately after success, and never start work for an already-aborted signal.

Complete the adaptive player control view model in src/player-controls.mjs. Phone and desktop layouts must expose the documented controls and accessible labels, while reduced-motion users receive no animated transition.
